verdict.rationale: cubic documents an official cubic CLI (`cubic review`) that reviews local, uncommitted changes before push and generates a prompt your coding agent can use to fix the findings. It can also use your ChatGPT Plus/Pro or Claude Code subscription for local reviews, which fits AI-native workflows well. Missing for 10: documented command surface beyond local review, installation and usage reference detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The **cubic CLI** reviews local changes before you push. It finds bugs and generates a prompt that your coding agent can use to fix them.
Connect your existing **ChatGPT Plus/Pro** or **Claude Code** subscription to use its models for local reviews.
